title: Live-Action A Side Character's Love Story Film's Final Trailer Features Theme Song
content: Comic Natalie streamed the final trailer for the live-action film of Akane Tamura 's A Side Character's Love Story ( Mobuko no Koi ) manga on Monday. The trailer features the film's theme song "Clover" by Nishina, which also appeared in the film's previous trailer.
author: ANN

title: Historie TV Anime Announces Lead Voice Actor, January 2027 Premiere
content: The July issue of Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine announced on Monday that LIDEN FILMS 's television anime of Hitoshi Iwaaki 's Historie manga will premiere in January 2027. Nobunaga Shimazaki will star in the series as Eumenes.
author: ANN

title: 5 Biggest Snubs of the Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2026
content: The Crunchyroll Anime Awards have come to an end, and while some anime fully deserved the titles they received, there were also several winners this year that arguably did not deserve their awards.
author: ComicBook

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Series Confirms New Return Ahead of Anime Revival
content: One of Shueisha’s Shonen Jump franchises is making a return eight years after its initial cancellation with a special release to go alongside its new revival anime coming this Summer.
author: ComicBook

title: KPop Demon Hunters Director Addresses Big Issue Facing the Sequel
content: KPop Demon Hunters has been such a massive hit that any follow up is going to be hard to get perfectly, and one of the directors behind it all is fully aware of this problem heading into the sequel.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen to Host Major Event Ahead of Season 4 This Summer
content: Jujutsu Kaisen made a big return to screens this year with its third season, and it’s hitting the stage with a major event later this Summer as it continues work on the fourth season. Jujutsu Kaisen made its comeback with its highly anticipated third season earlier this year.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix Confirms Streaming Release Date for One of 2025’s Biggest Anime Movies
content: Netflix has a whole new wave of releases coming to the streaming service this June , and with it has revealed the streaming release date for one of the biggest anime movies of the last year.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Releases Robin & Saul Reunion Insert Song by Maki Otsuki From Episode 1163
content: ONE PIECE released the special Robin & Saul reunion insert song “Sekai wa Hitori Janakatta” (The World Wasn’t Alone) following the premiere of Episode 1163. The song by Maki Otsuki is available on numerous streaming platforms .
author: Anime Corner

title: Ripley and Saul Appear in One Piece 1164 Preview
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1164, with Robin and Saul finally reunited at the legendary Elbaph Island. The anime returned after a 3-month break on April 5, with the crew reaching the giants’ Elbaph Island. Yuichi Nakamura was previously revealed as the voice of Loki.
author: Anime Corner
